title: MXR triangular inversion for Qwen3.6 on Ascend

paper.title: Fast and Stable Triangular Inversion for Delta-Rule Linear Transformers

objective: Reproduce the official MXR/PTO mechanism faithfully on Ascend, prove multi-step numerical correctness and target-shape advantage, then obtain attributable matched end-to-end performance without quality regression through a plugin-owned monkeypatch.

timebox.policy: one continuous wall-clock window; no pause or reset
timebox.deadline_rule: Push a scoped terminal checkpoint by the deadline. Environment failure does not become an MXR failure and does not extend the slot.

goal_alignment.long_term: Deliver reproducible and portable Ascend performance benefit through a plugin-owned implementation without modifying upstream frameworks or images.
goal_alignment.medium_term: Build a complete evidence chain: official-method parity, CANN 9.1 compatibility, NPU numerical correctness, target-shape kernel timing, matched dense end-to-end A/B, and final quality.
goal_alignment.short_term: By 2026-09-20T19:52:15Z, either pass the shared NPU canary and execute the prepared one-shot NPU4 numerical and target-shape timing gate, or push an environment-inconclusive terminal checkpoint without touching physical NPU0-3.

fixed_gates.stop_rule: Stop heavy integration and advance to the next portfolio item, DeltaLog, if the candidate has no clear target-shape kernel advantage, the attributable end-to-end gain is expected to remain below about 5 percent, or the hard deadline is reached.

terminal_result.scope: Qwen3.6-27B TP4 local geometry on Ascend 910B4 with the pinned vLLM-Ascend v0.23.0 and CANN 9.1 stack
terminal_result.numerical: Official staged PTO and MegaGDN candidates passed three chained output/final-state comparisons and bitwise replay at H=12, Hg=4, D=128. Direct MXR and v0.23 triangular solves also passed against the double reference and bitwise replay.
terminal_result.decision_reason: The paper mechanism does not cover decode and its attributable gain is below the predeclared about-5-percent integration gate. The larger official six-stage fusion is also below the 1.10x target-shape threshold at 32K and predicts less than one percent prefill NPU gain. Heavy service integration and final task-quality testing are therefore not justified for this candidate.

environment_blocker.error: aclInit 507899 Resource_Busy; torch_npu reports drv devId 0 invalid before any MXR code executes
environment_blocker.target_card_observation: Physical NPU4-7 were healthy, at idle-HBM baseline, and had no device-side process during each probe.
environment_blocker.kernel_evidence: The 2026-09-18T21:08:37Z post-release canary produced repeated Ascend UDA kernel errors: uda_occupy_dev_by_ns: Conflict open udevid (udevid=4; ns_id=0). npu-smi showed no process on any NPU and lsof showed no open target device file.
excluded_causes: missing host network or host cgroup namespace
logical index misuse after ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES remapping
missing ASCEND_DEVICE_ID index when ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES is set
environment_blocker.concurrent_state: The authorized dias-cont-1 stop completed without deletion. Its UDA claims disappeared and exactly one non-privileged physical-NPU4 canary completed a synchronized tensor operation on Ascend910B4. Before npu-gate-v2 started, the external controller created dias/agentgpu-910b4-qwen35-4b-v0, a sleep-infinity task exposing /dev/davinci0-7. It reclaimed every UDA device while npu-smi continued to show no compute process.
environment_blocker.uda_owner_evidence: After dias-cont-1 stopped, /proc/uda showed no ns_id 0 owner and the canary succeeded. At the npu-gate-v2 failure, /proc/uda/namespace_node mapped ns_id 0 to root_tgid 3523970 and udevid 0-7; PID 3523970 is exactly dias/agentgpu-910b4-qwen35-4b-v0 in cgroup /dias/agentgpu-910b4-qwen35-4b-v0. Kernel records tie the gate PID to Conflict open udevid 4, ns_id 0.
environment_blocker.recovery_semantics: Installed driver source uda_access.c shows root-process exit schedules namespace destruction and calls uda_uninit_ns_node_dev, UDA_UNOCCUPY, and uda_unoccupy_dev_by_ns. Stopping only the owning task is the narrow recovery candidate; no driver reset is justified first.
environment_blocker.next_safe_branch: Preserve dias-cont-1 stopped and undeleted, and preserve immutable npu-gate-v2. Do not stop or delete the new external agentgpu task without explicit approval. A later attempt must fail closed on UDA procfs ownership and keep the real canary plus MXR probe in the same device-scoped container namespace.

next_actions: Do not integrate or benchmark MXR/MegaGDN service code unchanged; reopening requires a materially different mechanism that also covers decode or a changed workload whose measured prefill opportunity exceeds the admission gate.
Preserve npu-gate-v1 through v11 as immutable environment, correctness, failure-isolation, and timing evidence; never overwrite or rerun a deterministic failure unchanged.
Advance the one-day paper portfolio to KVBuffer on physical NPU4-7, starting with source parity, real v0.23 seam mapping, and a measured decode IO opportunity bound before implementation.
Keep the target-lane priority policy: identify and release only new external workloads that actually overlap physical NPU4-7, while leaving physical NPU0-3 and disjoint workloads untouched.
